verdict.rationale: Skyvern's core architecture is vision-driven: it maps visual elements to actions and can operate on unseen websites 'without any customized code' (skyvern-gh-1), and its CAPTCHA solving explicitly uses 'its vision model' (skyvern-docs-9), with a community reviewer noting 'the computer vision aspect... a step beyond existing browser automation software' (skyvern-comm-4). However, this is presented as the platform's default/only mode rather than an explicit switchable action-primitive alongside a DOM-path mode, and no evidence addresses canvas-based UIs specifically. Missing for 10: documentation of an explicit mode-switch API/parameter between DOM-based and vision/computer-use action modes, canvas/non-DOM UI test cases, and independent hands-on confirmation of vision-only operation succeeding where DOM selectors fail.
